rule_metadata.title: Potential Kerberos Pre-Authentication Failure for Machine Accounts

rules.rule_text:
title: Potential Kerberos Pre-Authentication Failure for Machine Accounts
id: f932f9f9-a6bd-45e3-9a0d-ca613fe7fc40
status: experimental
description: 'Detects Kerberos pre-authentication failures for machine accounts, which
  may indicate attempts to brute-force service account passwords.

  This rule helps identify potential Golden dMSA attacks where attackers try multiple
  password combinations.

  When hunting, look for multiple 4771 failures for machine accounts in short succession
  with status code 0x18 (KDC_ERR_PREAUTH_FAILED). Distinguish these from 0x19 (KDC_ERR_PREAUTH_REQUIRED),
  which indicates that additional pre-authentication is required rather than that
  a password was incorrect.

  Hypothesis: An attacker is attempting to identify machine accounts with weak passwords
  for attacks like Golden dMSA by performing Kerberos pre-authentication brute-force
  against machine accounts (ending with $). Multiple failures in a short time window
  from the same source IP or targeting multiple machine accounts suggests credential
  guessing activity.

  '
references:
- https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/previous-versions/windows/it-pro/windows-10/security/threat-protection/auditing/event-4771
- https://ipurple.team/2025/09/02/golden-dmsa/
- https://www.semperis.com/blog/golden-dmsa-what-is-dmsa-authentication-bypass/
author: Panos Gkatziroulis, Swachchhanda Shrawan Poudel (Nextron Systems)
date: 2026-10-19
tags:
- attack.credential-access
- attack.t1110.001
- detection.threat-hunting
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4771
    TargetUserName|endswith: $
    Status:
    - '0x19'
    - '0x18'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
- Unknown
level: medium
